title: Customizing Form Fields on Member Registration with Form Manager

sections.heading: Customizing Forms in Form Manager
sections.content:
The Form Manager allows you to customize and reorder form fields on member signup, contact, and lead forms:
1. Go to Toolbox > Form Manager.
2. Locate the 'Listing - Contact Details' or 'Member Signup' form.
3. Click 'Customize'.
4. Add new custom fields (text inputs, dropdown menus, radio buttons, file uploads).
5. Set field validation to Required or Optional.
6. Click the blue 'Save Changes' button.

procedural_steps: Add custom fields or drag to reorder
Set validation rules and click Save Changes
full_text:
Customizing Forms in Form Manager
The Form Manager allows you to customize and reorder form fields on member signup, contact, and lead forms:
1. Go to Toolbox > Form Manager.
2. Locate the 'Listing - Contact Details' or 'Member Signup' form.
3. Click 'Customize'.
4. Add new custom fields (text inputs, dropdown menus, radio buttons, file uploads).
5. Set field validation to Required or Optional.
6. Click the blue 'Save Changes' button.
